onboarding.body: CEO Chat is a conversation with the employee appointed CEO. Hire a CEO now, or appoint an existing employee from your office. Orbit's records still answer the quick actions meanwhile.

unavailable.records: Orbit's records still answer the quick actions, and what was said stays here.

proposal.title: Proposed mission
proposal.responsible: Goes to {who}, who gives it to the departments.
proposal.changed: Who is responsible changed: it would go to {who} now. Check, then give it again.
proposal.inert: Nothing happens until you give it.
assign.title: Assign work to the CEO
assign.body: Say what needs to be done: the CEO gives it to the departments, and you see it here as it moves.
panel.title: About the CEO
panel.authority: Gives work only to departments, through their managers; reads no company system and runs no command.
